build_H3DNet_model: build an H3DNet 3D detector model with backbone, rpn_head, and roi_head components
run_forward_train: run the H3DNet forward training pass with point clouds and ground truth 3D bounding boxes
test_simple_test: test the H3DNet model on point cloud data and return predicted 3D bounding boxes
run_aug_test: run augmented testing on H3DNet with multiple point cloud views and merge 3D bounding box results
extract_feats: extract features from multiple point cloud samples using the H3DNet model
